    Bug 2056916 - Remove langpack products from Thunderbird esr bouncer-check. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,dandarnell
    
    Thunderbird ships langpacks via ATN, not bouncer, so remove them from
    release-bouncer-check on esr. They were copied from Firefox in bug 1874895.
    Beta/Release configs already omit them.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D313479

diff --git a/testing/mozharness/configs/releases/bouncer_thunderbird_esr.py b/testing/mozharness/configs/releases/bouncer_thunderbird_esr.py

             "product-name": "Thunderbird-esr-next-pkg-latest-SSL",
             "platforms": ["osx"],
